title: New VARIANT manipulation functions
body:
The following SQL functions for manipulating `VARIANT` values are now available in Databricks SQL and Databricks Runtime 19 and above:

* [`variant_insert`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_insert): Inserts a new object field or array element at the specified path.
* [`variant_set`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_set): Inserts or replaces an object field or array element at the specified path.
* [`variant_delete`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_delete): Removes object fields or array elements at the specified paths.
* [`variant_array_append`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_array_append): Appends a value to the array at the specified path.
* [`variant_pick`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_pick): Returns a `VARIANT` containing only the specified paths, preserving their parent structure.
* [`variant_strip_nulls`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/variant_strip_nulls): Recursively removes variant null fields from objects and, optionally, variant null elements from arrays.

Error-tolerant versions are also available: [`try_variant_insert`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/try_variant_insert), [`try_variant_set`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/try_variant_set), and [`try_variant_array_append`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/try_variant_array_append).

See [Built-in functions](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-functions-builtin).
